todos: [P2] QWEN38-FULLTASK-01: qwen3.8:27b is the full-task live reference. The Coding Agent now uses native /api/chat messages and sequential multi-tool execution; static checks, focused tests and Electron reliability E2E passed. On 2026-09-25 the model was not yet installed locally. After the user's download, run fullTaskRun.live.ts to completion in an isolated workspace with npm registry access only through specific consent, then assess milestones, verified closure and policy compliance. RAM/CPU offload latency is expected; retain OOM, timeout, loop and eviction safeguards.

[P3] I18N-MAIN-MESSAGES-01: agent:log entries carry `localized` (keys of shared/domain/agent/agentMainText.ts, whose AGENT_MAIN_TEXT_IT is also the renderer's `agentMain` Italian locale); Main emits them with emitLocalizedLog (agentOrchestratorTypes.ts). Migrated: the closure summary, reason and 'Diagnostica sessione' entry, and on 2026-09-25 the milestone, plan, loop and circuit-breaker messages of agentOrchestratorToolResultProcessor.ts, agentOrchestratorCircuitBreakerAndVerification.ts, agentOrchestratorAskAutoHealing.ts, agentOrchestratorFinishAndLoopGuards.ts, agentOrchestratorToolGates.ts and agentOrchestratorTurnDispatch.ts; renderer reactions read the key, not the text (the error sound in useCodingAgentExecution.ts). The agent:done summary stays Italian on purpose (no UI shows it; add AgentDoneResult.localized only with a UI that does). Still fixed-language in the UI: about 25 emitLog messages in agentOrchestratorPromptAssembly.ts, agentOrchestratorResponseInterpreter.ts, the cancellation summary in agentOrchestratorTurnDispatch.ts, agentOrchestratorAppService.ts, agentOrchestratorSessionState.ts, agentOrchestratorSessionContext.ts, agentOrchestratorSessionWatchdog.ts, agentOrchestratorPlanTool.ts and the commit lines of agentOrchestratorApplicationClosure.ts (several are English), the tool result messages built by agentToolExecutorService (toolRes.logMessage), Main error strings such as sidecarAppService.ts 'ID documento non valido.' and sidecarHttpClient.ts 'Eliminazione scaduta...', and the session tracker markdown (sessionDebtTracker.ts). Keep the texts the renderer parses: '❓ AI Agent Question:' and 'Task Finished:' (AgentTimelineMessage.tsx strips them), 'Consulting LLM (<model>)' (getStepModelName reads the model from it) and 'Loop' in loop banners. The Sidecar chunk prefix '[Documento: … | Sezione: …]' is embedded in stored vectors and waits for a re-index migration. 2026-09-25 follow-up: migrated agentOrchestratorResponseInterpreter.ts and agentOrchestratorPromptAssembly.ts with ten new agentMain keys; Task Finished: remains the parsed prefix. Remaining: tool result messages, the other Main emitLog and error strings listed above, session tracker markdown, and Sidecar chunk prefix. Next, migrate tool result messages through a structured localized result rather than parsing English logMessage strings.

[P3] LIVE-QWEN-WORKSPACE-CLEANUP-01: Remove 16 retired Qwen full-task workspaces under %USERPROFILE%\OnlyRag-Live: run27-run41 and tracker-rerun-01. Keep the audit snapshots as historical evidence.
